decisions.reason: As a multi-model product line on its own webpage that extends the established geospatial integration portfolio, it embodies visible investment and accumulated commitment that management is unlikely to reverse soon.

The building data digital twin service remains aligned with the firm's publicly stated move toward integrated and emerging geospatial solutions, so management can justify continued support by treating any slower uptake as a temporary market-development issue.

An open GIS application development framework is close to the firm's core technical identity and likely required substantial development effort across several models, which favors continued commitment rather than withdrawal.

Because this identity and access service was explicitly launched publicly and fits directly into the firm's GIS application stack, management is likely to keep backing it, especially after already concentrating its identity offering by dropping the adjacent Product C.

Although a workshop format is easier to adjust than a software product, its own webpage, very recent launch, and strong fit with the firm's consulting-led offer make continuation more likely than a quick discontinuation.
